label: sparse original-phase feature after q/3 context (unexplained)
explanation: Very sparse (0.012% of steps), weak feature (max 0.23). 93% of mass is in the original phase at t>=2, never t=0/1, with a peak on the final original token of L=9 sequences (orig_idx 8, 24x lift) and secondary peaks at t=2-3. It favours inputs v/h/l when the previous one or two inputs were q or 3 (e.g. p q 3 [l], 3 q [v]), and sequences rich in digits / starting with 1. It rarely fires in the delimiter or copy phase. But no clean predicate holds up: having seen both q and 3 covers about 36% of activations at under 1% precision, and the best conjunction (previous two tokens from {q,3,g,p}, current token from {v,h,l,o,s,p}) gets dev F1 0.12 (precision 0.07, recall 0.36). Magnitude shows no clear modulation by these conditions; the highest activations fall at the final original step of L=9 sequences.
